correctness.rationale: A direct blocking-pair contradiction shows that any stable 3x3 matching lacking a first-choice recipient must assign everyone their second choice. For all other stable matchings n<=3, both gap and ratio are strictly increasing functions of the worst partner rank. Borda utilities 1..4 yield the complete four-row ratio-gap table, guaranteeing a shared optimum at n=4. All 24 four-pair matchings of the explicit witness were tested: exactly two are stable; both have difference 2 but their ratios are 2 and 3. A standalone exact implementation verifies every profile n=1,2,3 and all the witness bijections with exact Fraction arithmetic.

value.rationale: Difference of extreme agent utilities and their ratio are mathematically distinct but practically substitutable fairness criteria only when their minimizers agree. This result gives a sharp structural cutoff for complete Borda-scored stable marriage and an explicit two-outcome market where the choice changes which stable solutions are accepted; a blocking-pair lemma explains the cutoff. The no-reversal result for four pairs prevents exaggeration of this finite boundary.
